reviews.reviewText: The 4K picture is crisp and the HDR makes movies look fantastic. Setup took less than ten minutes.

reviews.reviewText: Colors are vibrant and the smart features work well. Built-in speakers are a bit weak, so I added a soundbar.

reviews.reviewText: Works fine for casual viewing but the viewing angles could be better.
reviews.title: Average budget TV

reviews.author: PriyaK
reviews.reviewText: Active noise cancellation is excellent and the fit is comfortable for long listening sessions.
reviews.title: Best earbuds I have owned

reviews.author: JordanB

reviews.title: Great sound, case scratches easily

reviews.title: Disconnected often with my laptop

reviews.title: Kids love it
